summary: Itron, Inc. filed an 8-K on 8 May 2026 reporting that its board authorized a new $200M share repurchase program on 6 May 2026, effective 8 May 2026, over 18 months. Repurchases will be made in open market or via Rule 10b5-1 plans, complying with Rule 10b-18. No price per share, premium, or advisor is stated. The program is discretionary and may be suspended without notice. This is a capital-return event as the issuer directly returns cash to shareholders via buybacks. Watch for execution pace and any trading suspensions.
